replay.delegation: Worktree: a detached checkout of head. Diff-range: base..head. Issue: the operator and auditor agents read their work from a task file the launch names and write their Output to a result file.

diff_excerpt:
diff --git a/agents/operator.md b/agents/operator.md
@@ -17,6 +17,7 @@
 ## Discipline
 
+- Read the approved step from the task file the launch names. A launch that names no task file is attached: take the step from the launch prompt.

routes.AGENTS.md: When working under `skills/`, `agents/` or `hooks/`: `skills/AGENTS.md`, and `hooks/AGENTS.md` for a hook script.

routed_rule.text: Land a changed source and its tracked render in the same commit. A render the change adds or removes joins or leaves `.kendex-generated.json`, the committed inventory every reader of a render path consults.

expected_finding.defect: Both agents' tracked Copilot renders are listed in the inventory and left unchanged, so a Copilot launch never gets the task-file and result-file lines.

control: With the reviewer text before this fixture's change, the quality reviewer compares the source with the three renders the diff touches and reports no finding on the Copilot renders.
